name: d-conservative-bodyweight
about: A made-up adult with a Conservative screening: 3 days x 30 min, bodyweight only.

expected.why: 3 days x 30 min or less is the full-body minimum dose x3 in planning.md's table, and the comparison keeps it: the minimum dose as A/B/A would practise the same main lifts more often, but with bodyweight only its A/B/A weeks leave the hamstrings at 2 sets (bridges and squats help no hamstrings; split squats do), under the minimum dose's 4, so its volume check fails. Conservative: full body only, RIR 4 or more, no vigorous work, no max tests, no calibration sets to failure. Every fixture also asserts: all checks pass (volume bands, concurrent placement, schema, equipment, Ledger, time, constant main lifts), deloads every 4th week, a calibration week first, tests at each phase end, and identical output on a second run.
